partners.diseaseBName: syndromic X-linked intellectual disability Raymond type
partners.mechanism_chain: STT3A (HGNC:11057) —DISRUPTS→ N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486); N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); ZDHHC9 (HGNC:29091) —DISRUPTS→ Protein prenylation (GO:0016174); Protein prenylation (GO:0016174) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Protein prenylation (GO:0016174) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250). Loss-of-function mutations in STT3A disrupt N-linked glycosylation, contributing to intellectual disability and seizures in MONDO:0014270. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in ZDHHC9 disrupt protein prenylation, leading to intellectual disability and seizures in syndromic X-linked intellectual disability Raymond type. Both disrupted pathways converge on cellular processes essential for neuronal function, ultimately manifesting as overlapping phenotypic features.
